updates.note: Management states OSAT Unit 2 is on track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27, shifting the timeline.
updates.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27

new_promises.statement: Targeting commercial revenue booking for OSAT and PCB of INR 450 to 500 crores for this financial year.
new_promises.quote: we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time
new_promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar

new_promises.statement: Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai to be operational by quarter 3 FY27.
new_promises.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

new_promises.statement: Plan to capex at about INR 300 crores for OSAT and PCB each for the year.
new_promises.quote: Our current goal is to capex at about INR300 crores for OSAT and PCB
new_promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar

new_promises.statement: Plan to capex about INR 250 crores for EMS business for the year.
new_promises.quote: about INR250 crores for EMS business
new_promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar
